title: CPCSC Level 1 physical access authorization needs dated approval and removal records
remediation: The sponsor physical security owner inventories assessed facilities and maintains approved lists of people with physical access, credential issuance records and the approved review cadence. Retain a redacted review and a credential removal sample showing access ended when no longer required. Cite hosting provider evidence for any inherited facility. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect the assessed facility scope, dated access approval and credential issuance samples, and reviewed removal evidence
